title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 5: Letters Home

scenes.say: Back in country, Ali starts writing. He never wrote nothing before.
scenes.visual: a soldier writing a letter by flashlight on a cot inside a tent, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Dear Ma. I'm okay. That's the first lie.
scenes.visual: a handwritten letter on lined paper, a pen resting on it, dim light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He writes about the heat, the sand, the food. Never about Roddy.
scenes.visual: a stack of envelopes tied with string beside a canteen, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: His mother reads every word at the kitchen table in Newark.
scenes.visual: a woman reading a letter at a small kitchen table, warm lamp, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: She reads what he doesn't say. Mothers always do.
scenes.visual: a mother's hands holding a letter to her chest by a window, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: She writes back. Pray, baby. Even when you don't feel it.
scenes.visual: an envelope with a Newark postmark being opened in the desert, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He folds that letter and keeps it in his vest.
scenes.visual: a folded letter slipped into a military vest pocket, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Some nights it's the only thing between him and the dark.
scenes.visual: a lone soldier sitting on sandbags under a sky full of stars, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He starts to pray. Not pretty. Just honest.
scenes.visual: a soldier kneeling in a tent, head bowed, single light bulb, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Words become a weapon he never knew he had.
scenes.visual: a notebook filling up with handwriting, close up, pen moving, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Six. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a mailbox on a Newark rowhouse at sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 5 of 25: Letters Home. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
